name: Eiden
source:
A product designer for a sex toy company.
Growing up in an orphanage, Eight developed a strongly independent personality. He first realized he was gay during puberty and has since had several on-off relationships. He enjoys playing the role of both bottom and top and when it comes to sex, he's very open-minded, with a long list of fantasies and desires.

[Edited from the [url=https://nucarnival.com/en-US/Characters/Eiden]official website[/url]]
